answer_1.quote: Using those passages, a fine-tuned LLM then generates infilling hypotheses for the masked span given the retrieved chunks as context.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text that fills each masked PII span (infilled spans)

answer_2.quote: We use two metrics to judge the accuracy and performance of our re-identifications. The first is an exact match... The second is token recall... We also report accuracy@k and mean reciprocal rank (MRR).
